claims.text: Grand Hyatt Fukuoka is in the Hakata district in the heart of Fukuoka City.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Fukuoka is a luxury hotel located in the Hakata district in the heart of Fukuoka City, Japan.

claims.text: The hotel is connected to Canal City Hakata, a complex of business, entertainment and shopping facilities.

findings.quote: The hotel is connected to Canal City Hakata, a multidimensional complex of business, entertainment and shopping facilities.

claims.text: Rooms and suites embody an East meets West style.

findings.quote: Our hotel’s 378 rooms, including 16 suites, embody an “East meets West” style of accommodations.

claims.text: Depending on the room type, rooms have city views or views of Canal City Hakata.

findings.quote: Depending on the room type, guests may enjoy either city views or views of Canal City Hakata

claims.text: Rooms have spacious bathrooms with large tubs and separate showers.

findings.quote: spacious bathrooms with large tubs and separate showers

claims.text: The Hakata Suite has a Tea Bar, a dining table with integrated tea-making facilities and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship.

findings.quote: Thoughtfully designed with a Tea Bar, a spacious dining table with integrated tea-making facilities and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship, this suite offers

claims.text: The Japanese Suite is a ryokan-style room with futon sleeping on Japanese-style bedding, recommended for families.

findings.quote: This ryokan-style guestroom offers sleep on a futon with Japanese-style bedding, and is recommended for family guests.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has living, dining and work areas and a full kitchen.

findings.quote: spacious living, dining, and work areas, a full kitchen

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.

findings.quote: Maintain your swim routine in our stunning indoor swimming pool

claims.text: AN SPA FUKUOKA, in Club Olympus, offers aroma oil and Shiatsu massage treatments.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in luxurious treatments using aroma oil or Shiatsu massage therapy to correct imbalances in the body.
Treatments are available at AN SPA FUKUOKA in Club Olympus.

claims.text: THE MARKET F restaurant centers on an open kitchen and charcoal grill.

findings.quote: Experience a striking open kitchen and charcoal grill at the heart of the restaurant

claims.text: Bar Fizz serves cocktails, wines and spirits with live music.

findings.quote: Bar Fizz is the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a variety of cocktails, wines and spirits while being entertained by live music.

claims.text: From the hinoki soaking tub in the Japanese Deluxe Suite, guests can view a private Japanese garden.

findings.quote: From the bathroom with its hinoki soaking tub, guests can enjoy the view of a private Japanese garden.

claims.text: The Japanese Deluxe Suite has a Japanese tea ceremony room plus two tatami-mat rooms.

findings.quote: This 85-square-meter Japanese suite consists of a Japanese tea ceremony room, as well as an eight-tatami-mat room and a six-tatami-mat room.

claims.text: The first floor of Canal City Hakata is connected to the hotel's lobby level.

findings.quote: The first floor of Canal City Hakata is connected to the lobby level of our hotel.

claims.text: Kushida Shrine, Sumiyoshi Shrine, the Rakusuien Japanese garden and the Hakata Machiya Folk Museum are all within a few minutes' walk.

findings.quote: Visit several key cultural highlights of the city like the Kushida Shrine, the Sumiyoshi Shrine, the Rakusuien Japanese garden and the Hakata Machiya Folk Museum—all within a few minutes’ walk.

claims.text: The Grand Club lounge on the 5th floor serves breakfast, refreshments and an evening cocktail hour for Grand Club room and suite guests.

findings.quote: The Grand Club on the 5th floor is available for guests staying in Grand Club rooms and suites.
The lounge offers exclusive food and beverage services, including breakfast, refreshments and evening cocktail hour

claims.text: Several standard and Club Access rooms are for up to two adults, and rollaway beds cannot be used in them.

findings.quote: This room is suitable for up to 2 adults and please note rollaway beds cannot be used in this room.
This 34-square-meter room features a plush king bed and a spacious bath with a soaking tub and separate shower. Enjoy complimentary access to our fitness club and daily Grand Club access

claims.text: WhataHotel notes an urban setting within a busy commercial complex.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
